title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Agreement Terms: Early Termination, Withdrawal of Notice and Exit
content:
## 1. Early termination notice

1.1 A client may end its ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement before the term ends by a signed early termination notice. Its termination effective date is the later of the date the client asks for and the notice received date plus the tier's notice days in calendar days. A requested date after the term end date is a non-renewal, not an early termination.

## 2. Early termination fee

2.1 The clause "The early termination fee equals the early termination fee percentage of the per-seat rate times the minimum-commitment floor seats times the number of service months that begin after the termination effective date and on or before the term end date, rounded half up to the cent; it is invoiced on the date the notice takes effect on the agreement" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every early termination fee. It no longer governs the early termination fee of an early termination notice that the authorized contact signs on an agreement with exactly one early termination request awaiting signature, whose requested date is at least the notice days in calendar days after the signing date and so is the later of the date the client asks for and the notice received date plus the notice days; such a fee follows the exit-fee schedule and is invoiced on the date the signed notice takes effect on the agreement.

2.2 Every other early termination fee stays the early termination fee percentage of the per-seat rate, multiplied by the minimum-commitment floor seats and by the number of service months that begin after the termination effective date and on or before the term end date, rounded half up to the cent, invoiced on the date the notice takes effect on the agreement.

2.3 Non-renewal notices carry no fee.

## 3. Withdrawal of a notice

3.1 A notice may be withdrawn by the client only before the termination effective date. Withdrawal is possible up to and including the day before the termination effective date, counted in calendar days (a lead of 1 day). The date that governs is the termination effective date on the agreement's system record.

3.2 Boundary cases (hypothetical termination effective date 2025-09-30): a withdrawal on 2025-09-29 is in time; a withdrawal on 2025-09-30 is not.

3.3 On withdrawal of an early termination notice the early termination fee is reversed in full by a credit memo against that fee entry. A charge is reversed by credit memo at most once; a charge that already carries a credit memo reversing it is not reversed again.

## 4. Transition-out and closing

4.1 At the termination effective date the transition-out begins: the tier's included transition-out assistance hours are provided at no charge, and further transition assistance is quoted under a project statement of work at the tier's transition assistance rate per hour.

4.2 The agreement closes when the transition-out is complete; the client may request an export of retained documentation and configurations within the tier's data return window in calendar days after closing.

4.3 Unapplied service credits are forfeited at closing, and any balance due remains collectible.

## Hypothetical illustration of 2.2

A per-seat rate of 100.00, a floor of 20 seats, a fee percentage of 50 and 4 service months beginning after the effective date and on or before the term end: 50 percent of 100.00 is 50.00, multiplied by 20 seats and 4 months, giving 4000.00.

superseded_clauses: The early termination fee equals early_termination_fee_pct percent of seat_rate_usd times the minimum-commitment floor seats times the number of service months that begin after the termination_effective_date and on or before term_end_date, rounded half up to the cent; it is invoiced on the date the notice takes effect on the agreement.
